newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - GT Bicycles cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - GT Bicycles cut to hold.

text.p: Jefferies & Co analyst David Rose cut his rating on GT Bicycles Inc to hold from buy following the company's forecast Thursday of a second quarter earnings shortfall.
-- In a statement, Rose noted "a lack of earnings visibility amid a difficult domestic mountain bicycle market."
-- said "the near-term outlook remains too uncertain."
-- cut his second quarter earnings estimate to $0.06 a share from $0.25; lowered full-year estimate to $0.62 from $1.08, and cut 1998 to $1.13 from $1.44.
-- GT Bicycles shares were off one point at 7-1/4 at mid-morning.
